scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.check:repo: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); console.log('Checking git branch & size...'); console.log(execSync('git branch --show-current').toString()); console.log(execSync('git count-objects -vH').toString());"
